info.name: Bubble API
info.description:
REST API for the Bubble community platform. Serves both the React web client
and the React Native mobile app.

**Authentication** — most endpoints require a JWT supplied as
`Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Tokens are issued by `/api/auth/login` and
`/api/auth/signup`, expire after 7 days, and are invalidated on logout or
password reset.

**Rate limits** — auth endpoints are rate-limited (see individual operations).
Exceeding a limit returns `429 Too Many Requests`.
